evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: However, existing approaches focus on isolated subtasks, such as feature recognition, drawing interpretation, or tool selection, and struggle to support the full reasoning chain from design artifacts to process plans.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The parallel architecture achieves 100% success across downstream agents, Tool F1 scores of 95.9%-97.6%, 90% source detection accuracy in conflict analysis, and a 60%-68% reduction in token usage for key planning tasks.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: The framework is evaluated using 300 benchmark cases across three downstream ReAct-enabled agents, plus separate evaluations of CAD feature recognition, drawing analysis, and 2D-3D context fusion.
